nl.description: Jasper is gericht op marketingteams: campagnes, advertenties, blogs en social content in een vaste merkstem en huisstijl, met templates, workflows en samenwerking. Duurder dan algemene assistenten, maar ingericht op merkconsistentie.
bestFor: Marketingteams die op schaal content maken
notFor: Individuen die af en toe een tekst nodig hebben
limitations: Prijs per seat; Business-plan alleen op aanvraag

en.tagline: AI content platform for marketing teams, with brand voice
en.description: Jasper is built for marketing teams: campaigns, ads, blogs and social content in a consistent brand voice and style, with templates, workflows and collaboration. Pricier than general assistants but designed for brand consistency.
bestFor: Marketing teams producing content at scale
notFor: Individuals who occasionally need some copy
limitations: Priced per seat; Business plan on request only
